import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeRedesignRDNChart

/-!
# DD-4 redesign: the chart-reading ideal and its colength image

The chart reading map is only `R`-linear.  Its `R`-linear range is therefore not the ideal
generated by its readings in the chart ring `B = Γ(V)`.  This file records the actual
`B`-ideal and the scalar-extension maps that present its underlying `B`-modules:

* `chartReadIdeal K b = Ideal.span (range (chartReadMap K b))`;
* `chartReadIdealMap K b : B ⊗[R] K →ₗ[B] B`, whose range is `chartReadIdeal K b`;
* `chartIdealColengthModule K b s`, the image of `chartReadIdeal K b` in
  `B ⧸ Ideal.span {read s}`;
* `chartIdealColengthMap K b s`, whose range is that image.

The last module agrees with the previously landed `chartColengthModule`.  No flatness or
fibre-injectivity statement is made here: those properties for the `R`-linear range do not
automatically pass to this `B`-ideal.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe uR uB uM uN u

open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace LinearMap

/-- The range of scalar extension is the span, over the new scalar ring, of the original
range.  In particular, this is the precise map presenting the ideal generated by an
`R`-linear family of elements of an `R`-algebra. -/
theorem range_liftBaseChange_eq_span
    {R : Type uR} {B : Type uB} {M : Type uM} {N : Type uN}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module B N] [IsScalarTower R B N]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    LinearMap.range (LinearMap.liftBaseChange B f) =
      Submodule.span B (Set.range f) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro y ⟨x, rfl⟩
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    | add x y hx hy =>
        simpa only [map_add] using Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
    | tmul b m =>
        rw [LinearMap.liftBaseChange_tmul]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ b (Submodule.subset_span ⟨m, rfl⟩)
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(1 : B) ⊗ₜ[R] m, by
      rw [LinearMap.liftBaseChange_tmul, one_smul]⟩

end LinearMap

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] {a : ℕ}

namespace ThetaGeneratorSeed

/-- The genuine chart-ring ideal generated by the readings of `K`.  This is generally larger
than the `R`-linear range of `chartReadMap K b`. -/
noncomputable def chartReadIdeal
    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool) :
    Ideal Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) :=
  Ideal.span (Set.range (chartReadMap K b))

/-- The minimal scalar-extension map presenting the ideal generated by the chart readings:
`c ⊗ ψ ↦ c · read(ψ)`. -/
noncomputable def chartReadIdealMap
    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool) :
    Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) ⊗[R] ↥K →ₗ[Γ(relCurve C R,
      relPinnedChart C R π b)] Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) :=
  LinearMap.liftBaseChange Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) (chartReadMap K b)

set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
/-- The range of `chartReadIdealMap` is exactly the genuine chart-reading ideal. -/
theorem range_chartReadIdealMap
    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool) :
    LinearMap.range (chartReadIdealMap K b) = chartReadIdeal K b := by
  simpa only [chartReadIdealMap, chartReadIdeal] using
    (LinearMap.range_liftBaseChange_eq_span
      (R := R) (B := Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b))
      (M := ↥K) (N := Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b))
      (chartReadMap K b))

/-- The image of the genuine chart-reading ideal in the colength ring
`B ⧸ Ideal.span {read s}`.  Equivalently, this is `(chartReadIdeal K b + (read s)) / (read s)`,
viewed as a `B`-submodule of the quotient. -/
noncomputable def chartIdealColengthModule
    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
    (s : relThetaSections C R π a) :
    Submodule Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)
      (Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) ⧸
        Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s}) :=
  Submodule.map
    (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)
      (Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s})).toLinearMap
    (chartReadIdeal K b)

/-- The ideal-theoretic colength module is exactly the previously defined `B`-span of the
classes of the chart readings. -/
theorem chartIdealColengthModule_eq_chartColengthModule
    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
    (s : relThetaSections C R π a) :
    chartIdealColengthModule K b s = chartColengthModule K b s := by
  rw [chartIdealColengthModule, chartReadIdeal, Submodule.map_span, chartColengthModule]
  congr 1
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨m, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨m, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨chartReadMap K b m, ⟨m, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

/-- The scalar-extension presentation of the chart-reading ideal after quotienting by the
chosen section. -/
noncomputable def chartIdealColengthMap
    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
    (s : relThetaSections C R π a) :
    Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) ⊗[R] ↥K →ₗ[Γ(relCurve C R,
      relPinnedChart C R π b)]
      (Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) ⧸
        Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s}) :=
  LinearMap.liftBaseChange Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)
    ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s})).toLinearMap.comp
      (chartReadMap K b))

set_option maxHeartbeats 2400000 in
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
/-- The range of the quotient scalar-extension map is the ideal-theoretic colength module. -/
theorem range_chartIdealColengthMap
    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
    (s : relThetaSections C R π a) :
    LinearMap.range (chartIdealColengthMap K b s) = chartIdealColengthModule K b s := by
  rw [chartIdealColengthModule_eq_chartColengthModule]
  simpa only [chartIdealColengthMap, chartColengthModule] using
    (LinearMap.range_liftBaseChange_eq_span
      (R := R) (B := Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b))
      (M := ↥K)
      (N := Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) ⧸
        Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s})
      ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R
        (Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s})).toLinearMap.comp
          (chartReadMap K b)))

end ThetaGeneratorSeed

end AlgebraicGeometry
